notes: - Fixed Gen 1 co-op session restore so guessed Pokemon now reappear in the counter and grid after re-entering the quiz - Improved co-op quiz layout by aligning the player panel and chat, removing duplicate lobby text, and refining the background color slider - Added co-op chat image sharing from clipboard paste and drag-and-drop, with clickable thumbnails and an in-game image viewer - Improved co-op chat text with long paste support, selectable/copyable messages, and clickable web links - Fixed chat image upload crashes by sending image data in fragmented chunks, preserving normal-size images, and correcting upside-down pasted screenshots - Fixed co-op disconnect/shutdown scoreboard errors - Quiz titles now turn white when the background slider is set fully black
